title: Light bulb with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='38%' r='45%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff6b0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ffd83a'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#f5a623'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- warm glow halo -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='34' fill='#ffb700' opacity='0.18'/>
  <!-- glass bulb -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='url(#glow)' stroke='#fff3a0' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- big happy eyes -->
  <circle cx='41' cy='36' r='4.2' fill='#5b3a00'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='36' r='4.2' fill='#5b3a00'/>
  <circle cx='42.4' cy='34.6' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <circle cx='60.4' cy='34.6' r='1.5' fill='#fffbe0'/>
  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='45' r='3.6' fill='#ff8a4c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='45' r='3.6' fill='#ff8a4c' opacity='0.7'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M40 47 Q50 57 60 47' fill='none' stroke='#5b3a00' stroke-width='3.2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- screw base -->
  <rect x='38' y='62' width='24' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b8c2cc' stroke='#e3eaf1' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <rect x='38' y='68' width='24' height='6' rx='2' fill='#9aa7b4' stroke='#cdd7e1' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <rect x='38' y='74' width='24' height='6' rx='2' fill='#b8c2cc' stroke='#e3eaf1' stroke-width='1.4'/>
  <!-- contact tip -->
  <path d='M44 80 h12 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 6 h-4 a4 4 0 0 1 -4 -6 z' fill='#7f8b98' stroke='#c2ccd6' stroke-width='1.4'/>
</svg>
